blind.text: Your hand adjustments in the ratings: Inter Miami +0.08, Nashville SC +0.06, Seattle Sounders +0.05, LAFC -0.04
FIFA window Nov 9-17 ends the day before the Wild Card: call-ups, travel and knocks are not in the ratings
A level knockout game after 90 minutes is a coin flip (extra time not modelled)
Absences: each fixture adds back the listed regulars' value from the injury list (full-health ratings); a late scratch or a player missing from the list is not seen until Pinnacle's line moves
Eliminated clubs are docked 0.5 goals in the sim (they underperform the ratings by 0.36 goals, 2012-2025)
Playoff games: Pinnacle prices them off the same ratings as the regular season (13 seasons), so no playoff adjustment is needed
